reviewed_by: Automated static review (Radare2 0x004037C0..0x0040385E + Binary Ninja, paired Frida capture, 8/8 unicorn differential)

runtime_contract.note: The native writes the remap table and the action slot; the differential compares the table entry, the incremented action slot and the returned block's defined dwords. Retail leaves dwords 1 and 5 of the block uninitialised, so they are excluded from the comparison.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Radare2 and Binary Ninja both identify a single function at 0x004037C0; the candidate implements that entry and the CFG similarity is recorded in the manifest.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: The retail reads the QVM frame from its second argument and the frame reader 0x004B8A20 supplies the three script arguments; the port reads the same three values from the same frame view.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The action table base 0x00BC2358, the 345-dword stride, the count global 0x00BC2380, the (count-1)*115 slot arithmetic, the remap table base 0x00BC25BC, the three-dword stride, the 0x3FFFFFFF mask and the 0x00567C74 descriptor are the literal retail values.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: The port writes the same table addresses with the same strides; it returns a private 24-byte block where the retail writes the caller's buffer, and the difference is recorded in the status line.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: The only call in the retail body is the frame reader, which has no side effects; the port reads the frame directly and performs the same two table writes plus the action-slot increment.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Retail has one path: fill the block, return the destination in EAX. The port has the same single path and returns the block pointer.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: The function performs no floating-point arithmetic.

limitations: The destination-buffer ownership differs: the retail caller supplies it, this port returns a private static block.
The paired Frida comparison covers the returned class, not the block contents, because the block is only observable through the differential.
